content: Dhruv Kapoor called insurance agent Vikram Patel to inquire about the delayed renewal status of his health policy. Vikram explained that the underwriting team is still reviewing the application and apologized for the delay. To resolve the issue, Vikram agreed to escalate the case and promised to provide an update by the end of the day.

action_items: Escalate the application review to the underwriting team
Provide the customer with an update by the end of the day
